mechanism: Ginkgo biloba inhibits platelet-activating factor and has anticoagulant/antiplatelet properties, while nortriptyline as a tricyclic antidepressant may have mild antiplatelet effects, increasing bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding; consider alternative herbal supplement or use ginkgo with caution while educating patient on bleeding precautions; no absolute contraindication but requires surveillance.
